# Vendored tree-sitter grammars

sloplint vendors the grammar crates it parses with. Each directory is the
published crates.io crate, name and version unchanged, with a small
`grammar.js` patch and `src/` regenerated so that valid real-world source stops
reporting `meta/parse-error`.

## Layout

Every vendored crate follows the same layout:

| Entry | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `grammar.js` | the grammar definition, carrying the patch |
| `src/` | regenerated by `tree-sitter generate` (tree-sitter-cli 0.27.1) |
| `sloplint-grammar.patch` | the diff of `grammar.js` (and touched corpus) versus the published crate |
| `test/corpus/` | the upstream corpus, vendored so `tree-sitter test` runs in place |
| `test/corpus/sloplint_*.txt` | new corpus cases for each fixed shape |
| `SLOPLINT.md` | provenance, regeneration command, what is fixed, what still fails |

The workspace excludes `vendor/` (root `Cargo.toml`, `exclude = ["vendor"]`) and
each crate is referenced by a `path` dependency in `[workspace.dependencies]`,
so nothing here is re-published or rebuilt as workspace code.

## Regenerating

In a grammar directory, after editing `grammar.js`:

```
tree-sitter generate
tree-sitter test
```

Node is the JS runtime; `--js-runtime native` gives byte-identical `parser.c`.
Keep `sloplint-grammar.patch` in sync: it must hold exactly the difference from
the published crate, and `SLOPLINT.md` must describe the change and the
regeneration provenance.

## Index

| Crate | Upstream | Fixes |
|---|---|---|
| `tree-sitter-c` | tree-sitter-c | GNU extensions (`asm`, `__signed`, `#embed`, storage-class spellings) |
| `tree-sitter-cpp` | tree-sitter-cpp | 11 gap rows (expressions, preprocessor, attribute forms) |
| `tree-sitter-go` | tree-sitter-go | generic methods, type-parameter shapes, terminator recovery |
| `tree-sitter-javascript` | tree-sitter-javascript | tagged-template escapes, `await` chains |
| `tree-sitter-typescript` | tree-sitter-typescript | `using` declarations, keyword member names, decorator forms |
| `tree-sitter-powershell` | tree-sitter-powershell | script-argument parsing, native options, base-class chaining |
| `tree-sitter-ruby` | tree-sitter-ruby | `=begin`/`=end` block-comment edge cases |
| `tree-sitter-starlark` | tree-sitter-starlark | `assert` as an identifier |

Each `SLOPLINT.md` lists the exact upstream tag and the constructs that still
fail by design or by upstream limitation.

## Regression tests

`crates/sloplint-syntax/tests/grammar_gaps/<language>.rs` pins every fixed
shape through `analyze`; each module records which cases fail against the
published grammar, so a re-vendor that drops a patch fails the suite.
